Let's step back and think about the architecture. I want the audio capture to run on a real-time thread that writes into a lock-free ring buffer. Then a worker thread pulls samples, resamples them to 16 kHz, runs voice activity detection, and hands finish segments to the whisper engine. Keep the model loaded and warm the GPU when the hockey goes down. And measure every stage with signposts so we can see where the latency goes.
